audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart [Akshan x4, Skill x3] disagreed with content win[] and the packet [Akshan, Skill, Skill, Skill, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan] on six rows.
audit.why: Content whys are specific and kit-grounded: level 1 is his (Avengerang through the wave, passive shield/heal), 2-5 is skill play around Heroic Swing's 18s cooldown, 6 onward his Comeuppance execute and reset dashes keep the duel his while you win via teamfights. Aligned full sides to win[] with rewritten whys.
audit.corrected: Sides on rows 1-6 moved to match win[]; ratings adjusted; whys rewritten to argue the new verdicts.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray' fabricated in content early; kit names Viktor's E Hextech Ray.
audit.corrected: Renamed. Spike set (Q-poke sustain 3-5 / R+E all-in at 6 / lethality spike / late teamfight conversion) is sound.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad bleed; Going Rogue camouflage (vision requirement) and Comeuppance's 2500-range missing-health execute were absent from the bullets.
audit.why: Heroic Swing 18s rank 1, Comeuppance 100s rank 1, Viktor W 17s, R 120s. Going Rogue grants camouflage — Viktor has no reveal, so Control Wards and sweeper are mandatory (missingInteractions). Avengerang extends per enemy hit, so its return path is the poke to dodge.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with numbers; bleed bullets replaced with Avengerang-path and Comeuppance-execute content; camouflage warning folded into the roam bullet.

audit.why: Heroic Swing downtime is already the page's stated fight window; the 18s number is now attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: Terrain-cut retreat (missingInteractions: Swing around walls cuts your retreat and Viktor has no dash — hold Flash for the wall) not placed on the page.
audit.why: No lint-flagged field could carry it within the length band.

edits.before: Akshan wins by landing Heroic Swing, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Akshan wins by swinging in on Heroic Swing, shielding your burst with his passive, and executing with Comeuppance.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: His Avengerang pokes through the wave and his passive shields and heals him — the level-1 stat-checks go his way.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast, but his heal blunts single-spell poke — trades even to skill.

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: Heroic Swing (18s) lets him dart in and out — catch the swing with W and it's a skill fight, whiff it and you bleed.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. His dash-and-heal pattern keeps trades neutral.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Comeuppance executes from 2500 range and Swing gives repeat dashes — his all-in beats your weak point-blank storm.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: First-item lethality makes his Q-Swing burst outpace your Luden's spike — step up only with W and Flash ready.

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: His reset dashes keep the 1v1 rough even at two items — win by zoning teamfights with W, E and storm, not duels.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - W Gravity Field spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing (E): 18s at rank 1 — his engage AND escape; fight only while it is down. His R is 100s. - W Gravity Field (17s) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the 120s R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: His Avengerang extends its range each enemy it hits — stand off its line, laser through minions, and dodge the return.

edits.before: Akshan spends Heroic Swing early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Going Rogue is camouflage — buy Control Wards and sweep when he leaves lane with a mark up.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Comeuppance stores missing-health bullets from 2500 range — greeding at half HP is dying to a champion off-screen.

edits.before: Akshan bullies you at level 1: his Q (Avengerang) boomerangs through the wave and his passive shields and heals him off proccing marks, so he out-sustains any poke you throw. Play back, farm with E (Death Ray) from max range, and avoid standing in the return path of his Q. Don't try to win a stat-check trade early because his heal and burst beat your one-spell pokes. Give up a little CS to stay healthy rather than feeding an early lead.
edits.after: Akshan bullies you at level 1: his Q (Avengerang) boomerangs through the wave and his passive shields and heals him off proccing marks, so he out-sustains any poke you throw. Play back, farm with E (Hextech Ray) from max range, and avoid standing in the return path of his Q. Don't try to win a stat-check trade early because his heal and burst beat your one-spell pokes. Give up a little CS to stay healthy rather than feeding an early lead.

notes: Packet defect claims the chart contradicts Viktor's 53.13% winrate (Akshan 4/7 stages). I aligned full to the content/packet chart rather than re-adjudicating from winrate: the content whys ground each Akshan stage in his kit (Comeuppance execute, reset dashes) and frame Viktor's win as teamfight conversion, which is compatible with a favourable overall winrate. If the user wants the chart itself softened toward Viktor, that is a judgment call above kit evidence. Akshan's passive shield note: his P grants a shield on every third hit vs champions — Viktor burst math should respect it; mentioned in enemyWin. Comeuppance can be body-blocked by minions (first champion, minion or structure hit per Riot text) — did not fit any in-band field, worth a future pass. sectionsMissing: ahead, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, tradeGood/tradeBad remain structurally templated (tradeGood/tradeBad text is shared with other matchups but not lint-flagged here and factually generic-safe); nothing Akshan-specific fit at equal length without invention.
